title: Westall’s 55-year-old school UFO sighting - Teacher Andrew Greenwood
description:
Andrew Greenwood who saw a UFOs hovering over a Melbourne school says military officials threatened to have him fired if he ever spoke about the incident. The sighting had around 200 witnesses ranging from head masters to science teachers to regular students. He is talking publicly about the famous Westall High sightings 55 years ago for the first time in tonight's 7NEWS 'Spotlight' program.
